title: Lakehouse: scale-out N/A (fixed-size IaC; actionable)
description: Runs `nexus scale-out remove lakehouse spark-worker-3 --yes`. None of the lakehouse roles scale at runtime — the MinIO EC set is fixed at 4 (baked at format time), the Spark worker count + the pairs/ensemble are fixed-size IaC. The verb refuses with an actionable message naming the terraform path, never a silent no-op.

observe.what: an actionable N/A: the EC set is fixed at format time; worker/pair/ensemble growth is a terraform/Packer op

whatProves: LakehouseAdapter graceful-N/As scale-out for every role with an actionable message (EC set + worker count + pairs/ensemble are fixed-size IaC), never a silent skip.
